questions: Should the covariance matrix be computed before or after any duplicate column handling (if any) or other preprocessing?
Is the pair plot expected to include a diagonal (e.g., histograms or KDE plots) and off-diagonal scatter plots, or should it be customized (e.g., regression lines, kernel density estimates)?
Should the function handle NaN values in the DataFrame, or should it raise an error or propagate NaN in covariance/pair plot?
Is the covariance matrix required to be unbiased (default pandas) or should it use a specific ddof (e.g., ddof=0 for population covariance)?
Should the pair plot use default seaborn styling (e.g., color palette, grid lines) or is any valid PairGrid acceptable?
If the DataFrame has a single column, should the pair plot still be generated (a 1x1 grid with a histogram)?
Should the function raise an error if the DataFrame has only one row (since covariance with one row is undefined or zero)?
Is the order of return values strictly (covariance_df, pair_plot) as tuple, or could it be a tuple of those two in any order?
